Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results snippet and concluded that King Edward VII made the 1925 Birthday Honours without verifying the source content. This is historically incorrect, as Edward VII died in 1910; the 1925 Birthday Honours were made by King George V (born 1865). The Planner’s premature acceptance of an unreliable snippet and failure to cross-check led to the wrong king and thus the wrong birth year.
